regime_context: The detector shows Semiconductors narrowly leading AI Compute & Optics, with only 5 eligible themes and no one-narrative dominance. The absolute-trend gate historically failed to reduce drawdown in China A-shares (mean-reverting tape whipsaws the gate), weakening the reliability of trend-following signals. Coupled with a poor prior track record (2/7 hits), conviction must default low.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed handoff from Semiconductors to AI Compute & Optics. If AI Compute & Optics' score overtakes Semiconductors by >0.15 and its durability remains ≥0.45 with breadth >0.2 for 5 consecutive days, the rotation may be durable. Kill if Semiconductors reclaims a >0.3 margin or AI Compute & Optics durability falls below 0.3.

theses.thesis: Semiconductors (rank 1, trend tag, durability 0.58, breadth 0.364, not crowded) leads a narrow eligible set.
